source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why would a transcript containing an important promise near its end be useful for testing a notes skill?

options.text: It lets you use a longer generated answer as evidence of better coverage
options.feedback: Length does not establish that the important promise was captured. Inspect the output against the relevant source requirement.

options.text: It tests whether the procedure preserves an easily missed requirement
options.feedback: A difficult case can expose omissions that a straightforward transcript would fail to reveal.

options.text: It makes repeated runs of this transcript sufficient to assess varied inputs
options.feedback: Repeated success on this case provides evidence for that case. Representative inputs are still needed to assess other challenges.

options.text: It lets you judge completeness from the output without reopening the transcript
options.feedback: An output can sound complete while omitting a promise. Compare it with the source to check the relevant requirement.
